name: uv__tls_get

ownership.argument: Returns this thread's 808-byte libuv TLS block, allocating and initialising it from the template at 0x2CCF2D4C on first use. It is the accessor every libuv entry point calls, and it is what makes the pthread key below reachable.

provenance.source: References ../../apps/system/libuv/libuv/src/unix/nuttx.c with assert line 569; allocates 0x328 bytes through 0xC2DE120, copies the 32-byte template at 0x2CCF2D4C into the block, stores NaN at +0x320, and publishes the block with pthread_setspecific 0xC1F5478 under the key held in 0x201033AC.

notes: Anchor for the whole per-task chain: the key it uses and the block it returns define TASKINFO_UVSTATE and the loop slot.
